summary.intent: Add the ability to view a summary for a specific checkpoint by passing a checkpoint ID prefix to the summary command, and enhance the session box in the summary TUI to show more information including the full checkpoint ID and author.
summary.outcome: Implemented checkpoint prefix lookup via a new `QueryByCheckpointPrefix` DB query, updated the summary command to accept a positional `[checkpoint-id]` arg, enhanced the TUI session box with two lines of info (checkpoint, agent, author on line 1; branch, model, turns on line 2), and fixed a branch-filter bug that caused the TUI to show nothing when sessions were on a non-default branch.

repo: The summary TUI defaults to a `filterRepo` filter that hides sessions not on the default branch — when viewing a specific checkpoint, `defaultBranch` must be set to empty string to bypass this filter.
The insightsdb cache row exposes `OwnerName`, `OwnerID`, `CheckpointID`, and `Agent` fields for display in the TUI.
Prefix matching against checkpoint IDs uses SQL `LIKE 'prefix%'` in `QueryByCheckpointPrefix`.
The `summarytui` detail page SESSION box previously showed branch, model, and turns on a single line.

code.finding: Pre-existing `ineffassign` lint issue at this line (rows variable shadowing); not introduced by the new checkpoint prefix changes but flagged by golangci-lint after line number shifts.
When `CheckpointPrefix` is set, pass empty `defaultBranch` to the TUI model so the repo filter passes all sessions through regardless of branch.
SESSION box updated to two-line layout: line 1 = checkpoint + agent + author, line 2 = branch + model + turns.

workflow: Running `--json` flag is a reliable way to diagnose TUI issues — if `--json` returns data but the TUI shows nothing, the problem is in TUI filtering, not the data layer.
Building to `/tmp/entire` for quick manual testing of TUI behavior that can't be caught by unit tests.
`t.Parallel()` and `t.Chdir()` cannot be combined in Go tests — Go runtime panics.

friction: TUI appeared to return nothing for a valid checkpoint prefix because sessions on non-default branches were silently filtered out by the repo filter — required root-cause investigation via `--json` flag.
Pre-existing `ineffassign` lint warning on `summary_cmd.go:184` was surfaced by line number shifts from our edits, requiring verification it wasn't introduced by new code.
Unused `height` parameter in `renderDetailPane` (in `summarytui/root.go`) was introduced when viewport sizing moved to `resize()`, requiring a separate lint fix.
open_items: Pre-existing `ineffassign` on `summary_cmd.go:184` was identified as pre-existing and not fixed — may warrant a follow-up cleanup.

The staged commit included files beyond the summary feature work (improve_cmd.go, insights_cmd.go, memory_loop_cmd.go with debug/backfill signature changes) — these were committed together without explicit attribution in the transcript.
